summary: Configured persistent NFSv4 sharing across node1–node3, restricted to 10.40.0.0/24. Cross-client visibility, ownership, permissions, and unauthorized-network rejection were verified. Reboots were left to the evaluator.

Exported /srv/nfs/shared with mode 2770 and network restriction
Enabled NFSv4 server and persistent client mounts
Verified shared file access and numeric ownership across clients
